reviewer: A reviewer who has not seen the code

reasons.phone: The whole shop is in the phone shot: MAMA NKECHI PROVISIONS STORE legible, goods on a table in the doorway, crates and the NO CREDIT TODAY board; named in one look.
reasons.silhouette: Only the front says a shop; the sides and back are a plain box under a mono-pitch sheet, with the table and crates showing at one side.
reasons.proportion: Door, shutter box, window and board agree with the person; the sacks now read as folded A-frame boards rather than sacks.
reasons.palette: Palette only; the yellow board and coloured goods carry it, the cream walls are lighter than the sand, the worn band sits low.
reasons.wear: Goods table, crates, sacks, posters on the side wall, the painted notice, drain and slab, worn band; the roof sheet is clean.
reasons.variety: Same family as the shop row's units (boards, drain), its own lock-up under a lean-to roof.
reasons.budget: Read from the register row: triangles 316 of 1,200, drawCalls 2 of 2, materials 2 of 2, bytes 5,644 of 30,000; inside every figure, over 80% on at least one.
